review: friction-heating-trial@1 adds one general operation, friction-heating-trial (learning 4, 0.2 energy per study round), registered last for this run's scope, with modes inspect, trial, inspect-progress, resume and cancel and parameters targetIds (exact item ids, checked by the operation because an id list cannot use the shared resolver), quantity (1) and effortRounds (1-10, default 3). Reuse: small-combustion-source@1 of ex21 supplies, by import only, the conversion 1 energy = 21.6 kJ of hand work, the declared rod (900 kg/m3, length 25 diameters), the grip (1.5-5 cm), base (3 cm) and length (0.3 m) limits, rigidity, the represented composition (smallFireComposition, smallFireRod) and its contact-burn law; the ex17 values in long-thermal-physics.ts supply the 1080 s thermal round, the 20 W hand friction power, the contact law 0.5 + track depth / 3 mm, wear of 2 g per 21.6 kJ, smoke at 200 C, the ember condition of 2 g of dust at 350 C, wind cooling 1 + 0.5 wind, the still-air coefficient and the water, wood and latent heats; local-fire@1 supplies the 0.15 rain limit and 10% ash; ex19 supplies the plain-piece, whole-unit and firm-ground checks; probe's conventions supply unverified personal records and the available-heat field; ex21's modules and package are not edited and every earlier package is byte-identical by an id@version hash assertion, while drillRound, beds, tinder ignition and combustion are not called because they have no force, stroke, heat capacity or persistent thermal state or are not asked for. inspect (1 round, 0.2) reports for 1-4 ids each piece's ownership, whole units, origin, age, declared rod, surfaces, wear from earlier trials, role fit and problems, species and moisture as unknown, the contact (force, friction, stroke, speed, power, rubbing seconds, contact share), the base site, rain, wind, roof, light, safety and every unmet requirement, reserves and uses nothing and stays attached for 10 rounds while the same pieces are unchanged; trial reserves two owned whole units (one id twice splits one unit exactly, as collective-work reserves), pays a 0.2 inspection round unless one is attached, then rubs one paid round per round; a later trial on the open work starts a new bout after fresh checks, resume continues a paused bout, cancel takes 1 round and no energy, and every refusal (object, ground or other person's item, food, equipment, unrepresented or bent shape, wrong thickness or length, other quantities, other apparatus, no site, unsafe effort, low energy) comes before any cost. Modeling assumptions: bounded effort is a 50 N press with friction 0.4 and a stroke of min(0.25 m, half the base) at 2 cycles/s, so a full stroke gives 1 m/s and 20 W, and rubbing lasts until the round's 0.8 energy (17.28 kJ) is used, 864 s, the rest of the round cooling, so friction work never exceeds the paid input; the heat share 0.5 + depth/3 mm enters a 6 J/K hot spot (its wood layer, water and dust lumped at fixed capacity) and the rest the two 50 g zones beside it; the spot loses 0.012 W/K into each zone, convection 10 W/m2K on 4 cm2 times 1 + 0.5 wind and radiation with emissivity 0.9, each zone convection on 100 cm2, in explicit 10 s steps; while rubbing the wood draws water to the spot at 1.9e-5 kg/s times the pieces' mean water share, up to the water its 4 g layer and dust hold at that share, which evaporates above 100 C for latent heat plus heating from air temperature and is debited from the pieces' actual water, so the represented branch share of 0.5 holds the spot at 100 C while seasoned wood near 0.15 or drier can pass 350 C; wear splits inversely by hardness, debits each unit's represented per-unit composition (physical, the mass ledger carried load already reads), so fractional wear needs no rounding, turns worn dry solids into dust at the spot and worn water into spot water, deepens a 1 cm base track along the stroke and ends the work when the track reaches half the base thickness; the base lies across in front of the person at the first of eight directions, from east counterclockwise, whose 0.52 m point and footprint are inside the world, visible, firm (not water, a wet bank, waterlogged or saturated) and clear of people, objects and loose ground items; effort is unsafe below health 20, at zero satiety or with body temperature outside 7-34 C; dust of 2 g or more at 350 C or more while rubbing with rain of 0.15 or less (a roof keeps rain off) forms exactly one ember object at that point, taking that dust and its heat from the spot and referencing the work, its pieces and the dust debit, and that round pays only the rubbing done, 0.8 times the seconds rubbed over 864; the ember holds 18 MJ/kg of dry dust (declared), burns its dust with time constant 600 s / (1 + wind) into 10% ash, loses heat by convection on 15 cm2, radiation and 0.01 W/K into the ground in backward-Euler 10 s steps, stops glowing below 300 C, under 0.05 g or in rain above 0.15 and then only cools, never releases heat without dust, and runs every round regardless of the person, after completion, cancellation or death; its stored heat in MJ is its available heat, so the inherited thermal assessment lists a glowing ember as a reachable heat source while heating stays refused and probe heat trials stay impossible (they need 0.1 MJ); a body overlapping its footprint of 3 cm radius loses 5 health per 2 MJ the ember released that round; nothing spreads, no tinder, flame, warming of people, shelter or food heating exists. Lifecycle: another action pauses the bout after the round without charge, a continuing round whose live checks fail (moved away from the base, site, safety, energy) pauses without charge and the same checks refuse a resume or new bout, changed, lost or transferred pieces end the work as invalidated, death releases the pieces once to the death rules, and closing leaves the dust and contact water as a recorded residue at the contact point (no item, since no interface collects dust); open contacts cool every round with no water drawn, and closed ones until within 0.5 C of air, so a resume continues the cooled state; the public record shown with active work holds pieces, site, contact, bout, paid energy and rounds, an estimated contact warmth in 10 C steps, dust, track depth, observations and stop reason, never water share, water or vapour, while the exact mass and heat ledgers stay in world state. No reward: no satisfaction rule; the practice evidence is the ember event, which never carries a qualified flag; records are unverified; events carry no top-level progress, elapsed or remaining numbers; the ember has no creator, so it is never counted as made work, with incentives off or on. Visuals: no components; events carry trial view metadata (work, actor, exact pieces, location, contact angle and orientation, stage, display of inspection, rubbing, paused, interrupted, no ember, ember, ended or cancelled, paid energy and rounds, rubbing seconds, warmth, dust only when worn, smoke only from a modeled 200 C contact, glow only with the ember, never flame), and the ember object carries its source, provenance, remaining dust, ash, temperature, release rate and extinction state, labelled glowing, out and still warm, or cold residue, without thresholds.
